Commentary.Commentary: That is the end of this series. The trophy is handed to Pat Cummins. A comprehensive win as Australia clean sweep the series. A big turnaround for England as they were handed the medals just a few weeks ago and will go home with a bittersweet ending. Do keep checking the schedule page as the action keeps on coming. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Pat Cummins, the captain of Australia says it has been a fantastic series, the bowlers and the batters have done really well. States it was a tricky wicket and Head and Warner were brilliant. Mentions the way Head has played was brilliant. Ends by saying this win has given them a lot of confidence heading into the Test series and they are looking forward to it.
Jos Buttler, the skipper of England says they tried their best, he admits Australia outplayed them, adds there is a lot to be proud of though of what they have achieved in recent times.

David Warner wins the Player of the Series. He says it is the team which has been brilliant and they have played really well, the bowlers and the batters have been really good. Laughs, 2024 is a long time away and if he keeps fit and keeps scoring runs, he might be here again. Credits Pat Cummins for the way he has captained and he just wants to concentrate on contributing for the team. He would feel great if he can captain a Big Bash side and help the youngsters come through.mo

Travis Head wins the Player of the Match. He says he was trying to stay positive and play his shots and it was nice he could get things going. Adds he and Warner both try and be positive and score freely and they like attacking the bowling and it has been a good start.
...Presentation coming up...

Australia on the other hand, were brilliant with the bat first and were equally good with the ball. All their bowlers got a wicket at least but Adam Zampa was the pick. However, the way Josh Hazlewood and Pat Cummins bowled with the new ball was brilliant too. Overall, it was a clinical show by the hosts. The star of the show were the openers of Australia, 150 by Travis Head and 100 by David Warner honestly put this game on the bed.

Another dominating win for the Aussies and they have completed the whitewash! This game though was done and dusted in the first innings itself. Above 350 on this wicket was going to be an improbable task and England have fallen well short. None of their batters managed to cross the 40-run mark and that is not what you need when chasing such a big score. Roy though was the only positive as he did find some form but overall, it is a game the English would want to forget.

OUT! BOWLED! There it is! Zampa ends with four wickets! Floated, on middle, a googly. Stone looks to slog-sweep but misses and the stumps are disturbed. AUSTRALIA WIN BY A BIG MARGIN OF 221 RUNS, DLS METHOD.
Full and on leg. Willey tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Two in a row! Flatter and around off. Willey thumps it straight back over the bowler for a boundary.
FOUR! Flighted full and on off. David Willey slog-sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Stone looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge, that was close to the pole as well.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and outside off. Stone drives it through covers for a boundary.
Marsh goes for a yorker at the base of leg, it was tailing down. Stone looks to work it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but nothing given.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Mitchell Marsh gets his first wicket. Short in length and outside off. Liam Dawson tries to hit it hard across but gets an outside edge to Alex Carey who makes no mistake. Australia inching closer to clean sweep.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Short in length and outside off. Liam Dawson swings his bat and misses.
This is full and on middle. Liam Dawson lofts it high and clears the mid on region. Two runs.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is hit down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.

A loud appeal, Zampa was pleading but the finger stayed down! Australia have reviewed for an LBW. If no bat, that is plumb. ULTRA EDGE SHOWS NO BAT! BALL TRACKER SHOWS IT TO BE MISSING OFF! NOT OUT! Did not see that coming. Even Australia can't believe it. This is full and on middle, Dawson looks to play the paddle scoop but misses. He gets hit on the pad. Australia in the end, lose a review.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
This lands on off and spins away. Willey looks to push but is beaten.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! This is short and angling away from the off pole. Curran looks to slam it over mid off but it goes off the splice and it is taken by Josh Hazlewood there.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Hazlewood b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Quite down the leg side, Curran looks to paddle scoop but misses.
This time he does pull it but towards square leg for one.
Goes short, Dawson looks to pull but misses again.
Well fielded! Shorter and outside off, Dawson cuts, Stoinis at point, dives to his right and stops it.
Outside off, this is flayed through point but only one.
Floats it up on off, Curran strokes it down to long off for one.
On off,this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Out comes the sweep, this is hit wide of the fielder at deep square leg for a boundary.
On middle, this is thumped down the ground to long on for one.
Pushes this through and outside off, Curran is late on the cut and is beaten.
SIX! That is an outrageous shot! This is slightly shorter and on off, Curran, off the back foot, lifts it over mid off and it goes all the way.
Now looks to play the paddle scoop but this is bowled short, Dawson misses.
This one lands safe! Shorter again and on middle, Dawson looks to pull, this goes off the splice towards deep mid-wicket for two.

DROPPED AND FOUR! That is a really good effort from the sub fielder! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled nicely. It is going over the fielder at deep square leg. He runs back and then dives, gets two hands to it but it does not stay in. The ball rolls to the fence.
Another single as Curran now tucks it on the leg side.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit hard back towards the bowler who misfields and a run is taken.
This lands safe! On middle, Dawson looks to play the slog sweep, it goes off the top edge and lands in the mid-wicket region for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked to mid on.
BEAUTY! Flatter and on off, this lands and turns away. Dawson is beaten as he tries to defend.

OUT! Into the hands! Moeen Ali steps out, he gets to the pitch of it and looks to hit it down the ground. He gets a little too close to the pitch of the ball, does not get the elevation he wanted and hits it straight to long off. Marnus Labuschagne takes it nicely. It is all falling apart a little too quickly for the visitors now.
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Short in length and on off. Curran looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the back leg.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
More authority on the shot. Length and outside off, punched to deep point for one.
FOUR! Short ball on middle. Ali pulls but gets a leading edge behind the keeper and for a boundary.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Short in length and outside off. Ali has a swing across but misses.
PUT DOWN! Second one down by him! A leg--spinner, touch short and outside off. Curran flat-bats it back to Zampa who gets low to his left but fails to hold onto it.
Zampa is making up for the dropped catch! Lovely delivery! This is full and outside off, turning more away. Curran tries to slog it but misses.
Around off, kept out.
Almost had him! Flatter and on middle, turning in. Curran leans to flick it past short leg for a single.

OUT! LBW! That looked plumb and that is why Chris Woakes walks without thinking to review it. Zampa floats this full and around off, it's the wrong 'un. Chris Woakes tries to defend on the back foot but gets rapped on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. It goes onto hit the leg pole, as shown on the replay. Adam Zampa is on a Hat-trick.

OUT! TAKEN! This is really a soft-dismissal! Flatter ball, outside off and spins away sharply. Jos Buttler stays back as he heaves across only to get  a leading edge where Marcus Stoinis takes the skier at point.
Commentary.Howout: c Marcus Stoinis b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, Buttler is off the mark as he flicks this past square leg for one.
On a length and on middle, tucked to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Buttler punches it to mid off.

OUT! TAKEN! To be honest, Vince never looked settled. Short of a length and around off. Vince tries to pull but gets a top edge. The ball stays in the air for a long time before the fielder takes an easy catch at fine leg. Sean Abbott gets a wicket for his good work.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Mackenzie Harvey b Sean Abbott

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Vince scores his first boundary. On a length and outside off. Vince thumps it past mid on for a boundary.
On a length and around off. Vince blocks it out.
Flatter and on middle. Ali comes down the track and plays it back to Zampa.
A googly, on middle. It is blocked out.
Floated on middle. Ali heaves it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on middle. Ali misses his flick. It was pitching outside leg.
Tossed up on middle. Vince flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Much needed! Beautiful stroke! On a length and outside off. Ali smacks it well over mid off for a boundary.
On middle, another solid defense from Ali.
A length ball on middle. Ali again blocks it.
On a length and around off. Ali blocks it out.
Full ball on middle. Vince heaves it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Punched to cover.
1 run.
1 run.
DROPPED! That should have been taken! Zampa the culprit! Shorter and outside off, Moeen slashes at it, it flies off the outside edge down towards third man. Zampa looks to take it but spills it.
Another one shorter and outside off, Vince looks to cut but misses.
Outside off, shorter, Ali looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Length and on off, Ali pushes it to covers.
On off, defended.
Shorter and outside off, Vince slashes but misses.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, Vince looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the body.
On the stumps, defended.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Ali slashes but misses.
Late swing! This starts around middle and tails back in. Ali looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over square leg for two.
On the bounce to the fielder! On middle, this one holds in the surface. Moeen looks to drive but ends up lobbing it but it lands short of mid on.
On middle, defended.
Half an appeal but turned down! Length and outside off, this one jags back in after landing. Vince looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This is fuller, Moeen looks to drive, it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
On off, kept out.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
On off, Ali defends it onto the ground.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Tough chance though. Good effort! Outside off, Moeen throws his hands at it, this flies off the outside edge towards first slip. Smith leaps to his left but it goes through his hands. A single in the end.
Outside off, shorter, Moeen looks to cut but misses.
This starts on middle and then comes back in. Ali looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Sent back in time! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket. Moeen wants a run but is sent back.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Cummins strikes again! Just too quick for Billings! Cummins steams in and serves a short ball, outside off. Billings stays back as he looks to pull but gets a top edge and Pat Cummins on his follow-through didn't move much as he took the skier with ease. England in early trouble.
Lovely delivery! Short in length and outside off, this one swings back in sharply. Billings is squared up as he looks to defend.
Length ball, outside off. Billings keeps it out again.
Outside off, kept out.
Short in length and outside off. Billings punches it to point.
Outside off, Sam works it to cover.
Angled on the hips, flicked behind square leg for a single.
This is full and outside off. Billings again prods to drive but misses.
Outside off, guided to backward point.
Length ball, slanting on middle. Billings closes the face of the bat too early and gets a leading edge, flies over cover for a couple.
Beauty of a delivery! A length ball, this one starts on off and then moves away. Billings looks to push but misses.
A length ball on off. Vince tucks it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Pitched up, outside off. Billings gets on the front foot and plays a lovely off drive past mid off for four runs.
Wide! Short ball, goes down with the angle. Billings misses his flick, wided.

OUT! LBW! Touch fuller and around off, nips in a bit. Roy shuffles way to across as he looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Jason Roy takes the review. No bat there clearly. Ball Tracking shows it goes onto hit the top of off. OUT IT IS. The 42-run stand is broken.
Beauty! Touch short and around off, this one swings in and goes over off pole. Roy was beaten comprehensively.
A length ball, outside off, this one straightens up. Roy is drawn forward to push but mises.
A length ball, way outside off. Vince cuts it to third man for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
On a length and on off, tucked to square leg for a single.
This is full and on middle. Roy flicks it to square leg for a single. It went of the bat but Australia were appealing for LBW.
A length ball, outside off. Roy punches it to cover.
Short in length, outside off. Vince pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off, defended.
This is full and outside off. Vince drives square on the off side for a couple more.
Just 2 off the over! A length ball, outside off. Roy mistimes his flick to mid-wicket.
Outside off. Roy keeps it out.
A length ball, outside off. Roy tries to break the shackles as he swings across but misses.
50 up for England! This is full and on middle. Roy flicks it through the gap to mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A length ball, outside off. Roy knocks it to point this time.
Length ball, outside off. Roy lets it go.
A short one and on the body, it is pulled down to fine leg for one.
Steps out and goes after this ball outside off, Roy slashes but misses.
Outside off, not played at.
Three more! Outside off, Vince guides it through point for three.
Outside off, Vince slashes at it but misses.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Flicked away! On middle, this is worked past mid on and it races away to the fence.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Roy looks to cut but is beaten.
Just outside off, left alone.
On the stumps, it is kept out nicely.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
FOUR! Two in a row and can this be the momentum shifting over! On middle, Roy clips it stylishly through mid-wicket. No chance for any fielder.
FOUR! Gets it through! Shorter and outside off, Roy stands tall and strokes it past cover. Races away.
Another peach! This is on a length and outside off, this one lands and jags back in too. Roy looks to drive but the ball goes past the inside edge and goes over the off pole.
Continues to land it on a length, Roy guides it to point.
On off, Roy plays it back to the bowler.
Back of a length and on off, this one jags back in. Roy looks to flick but misses to get hit on the body.
Outside off, left alone.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, Roy shows the full face of the bat and strokes it to mid on.
On off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
On middle, Vince tucks it to mid-wicket.
This is unplayable stuff! Length and around off, this lands and moves away. Vince is beaten as he tries to defend.
A dot to end! Length and on off, this is guided to point.
Not easy to hit these! Sees Roy come down the track and bangs it short and outside off, this lands and jags back in. Roy is cut into half as he tries to cut.
WIDE! Now tries to bring it back in but bowls it down the leg side. Wided.
It is doing a lot! This is yet another delivery on a length and outside off, it lands and moves away. Roy is beaten as he tries to poke at it.
Short and on the body, Roy looks to pull but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side, wided.
Outside off, shorter, Roy looks to cut but is beaten.
Cuts Roy into half! This is on a length and outside off, this lands and comes back in. Roy's inside edge is beaten as he tries to put bat on ball.
FIVE WIDES! That did not come out right! This is short and well down the leg side. Roy looks to pull but misses. The keeps swinging away from the keeper and goes down to the fine leg fence.
A length ball on middle. Vince shuffles across as he looks to flick but mistimes it back to Josh Hazlewood.
Outside off, tapped to short third man.
A length ball, outside off, swings away a bit. Vince is beaten all ends up.
On a length and on middle. Roy tucks it to mid on for a quick single.
Wide! Tries to find the swing but this is down the leg side. Wided.
FOUR! Too straight this time on the pads and Roy clips it past square leg for a boundary.
This one swings in on middle. Roy steps across and plays with the angle to mid-wicket.
Back in length and outside off. Vince has a poke at it but misses due to the away movement.
Ouchh! Vince is getting troubled! Short of a length and on middle. Vince gets hit on the box as he looks to defend.
That looked close but probably doing too much! Full ball, swinging on the pads. Vince looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was going down.
Short in length and outside off, Vince taps it to point.
This one moves away now, full and outside off. Vince looks to drive but misses.
This is really good bowling! Movement off the pitch! Length ball, outside off, this one lands and nips in. Vince lets it go as he covers his stumps.
This is full and outside off, it is driven to the left of mid off for a single.
Wonderful delivery! On a length and outside off, this one nips back in. Vince shoulders arms but gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was pitching out of the line.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Left alone.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Josh Hazlewood has the first one and it is the wicket of the in-form batter! A length ball, way outside off at 137.2 clicks. Malan is tempted as he looks to drive but the ball just nips back in and takes the inside edge. Alex Carey pouches it behind.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! This is full and around off, it skids through. Roy looks to defend but the ball bounces and hits him high on the pads. It rolls to third man for a leg bye.
Full and on off, Malan mistimes his flick to mid-wicket for one.
On a length and around off. Malan plays it late and back to the slip cordon, all through the ground.
Short ball, outside off and nips away very late. Roy slashes and misses. Interest comes from behind the stumps but not reviewed.
FOUR! This time hits it nicely. Full and on the pads, this is flicked through square leg for a boundary.
In the air but lands safely! This one sticks a bit in the surface, short and outside off. Roy tries to clip it past mid-wicket but mistimes and luckily it goes over the fielder there. Two runs.
On a length and around off, Roy comes down the track as he blocks it to cover.
Short and outside off, swings away. Roy thinks to play at it but leaves in the end.
FOUR! First off the chase. Short of a length and outside off. Roy punches it sweetly through point and the ball races into the fence.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Pat Cummins.
On a length and around off. Roy looks to defend but splices it to third man for a single.
On a length and outside off. Roy punches it to mid on.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket.

Malan is off the mark! Short in length and on middle, this one swings late. Malan steps across, fends it to square leg and runs across. The fielder runs in, underthrows but misses his shy at the batter's end.
Leg bye! Short in length and on the hips, Roy misses his flick and it goes off the hips to square leg.
Josh Hazlewood starts with a length ball, around off. Roy steps forward and blocks it out.
